workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've got the calendars for Priya and Marcus. Can you check Elena's and David's calendars and find a 30-minute slot that works for everyone?

Here are the times that are BUSY for either Priya or Marcus:
Mon: 10:00-11:00, 11:30-15:00, 15:30-17:00
Tue: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30
Wed: 09:30-12:00, 12:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:00-17:00
Thu: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-13:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00
Fri: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00

Let me know what you find.

Thanks,
Alison

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. The only 30-minute slot available for all four partners next week is Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00. Please book this time. Once it's confirmed, I will send the confirmation email. Thanks, Brad.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, the meeting has been booked for Thursday at 14:30. It's over to you to send the confirmation email. Thanks, Alison.

emails.body: Dear Partners, this email confirms your 30-minute meeting has been scheduled for Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00 Eastern.
